description: Manage Endfield updates separately. Drafts are visible only to administrators; published entries appear on this site's changelog.
empty: No releases yet. Create the first one.
translationHint: Simplified Chinese is required. Traditional Chinese and English are optional and fall back to Simplified Chinese when empty.
title: Release title
saveHint: Save the draft before publishing. Published version numbers are locked. Future-dated releases cannot be published yet.
saved: Draft saved. Public content is unchanged.
updated: Done. Refresh the public changelog to see the update.
accessDenied: Only administrators can manage releases. Sign in with an administrator account.
conflict: This release changed, or the version already exists on this site. Your edits are preserved. Refresh the list and select the release again to review it.
invalid: Check the version, date and Simplified Chinese content: titles allow 120 characters, items 500 characters, and sections 12 items. The publication date must not be in the future.
requestFailed: Request failed. Your edits are preserved. Please try again.
discardConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
publishConfirm: Publish this saved Endfield release? All visitors will be able to read it on the Endfield changelog.
withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this release from the public changelog? The draft will be kept.
deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this never-published draft? This cannot be undone.
